newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar recovers on festival buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar recovers on festival buying.

text.p: Sugar prices bounced back from the reduced level on the local market on Wednesday as dealers prepared for the Hindu festival season.
"Fresh physical buying ahead of the festival coupled with eased pressure of arrivals drove a recovery," one dealer said.
Sugar was down 25/50 rupees per quintal last week after the federal government announced a higher free sale quota.
"Free sale quota for current month is 725,000 tonnes which will be hiked to 850,000 tonnes for October," a broker said.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 rose 10 rupees to 1,305/1,330 rupees per quintal. M-30 rose to 1,330/1,400 rupees per quintal.
